title: ChatGPT Health Just Launched for Every US Adult: What It Does
description:
AI can now legally see your health data, for hundreds of millions of people at once 🔥

OpenAI just launched ChatGPT Health to every US adult, from the free plan up to Pro. It links with Apple Health, Peloton, MyFitnessPal and your medical records via b.well. It reads your labs, explain diagnoses and preps questions for you doctor ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
